source.reductions: Keep the FluxInstance, generated sync Kustomization, and Plex patch chain. Use working-tree charts for the original cases and a values-driven OCI generator for named-oci.

cases.name: patch-chain
cases.description: Apply the generated sync root in full and narrow builds and compare the Plex Kustomization.

cases.name: descendant
cases.description: Apply the covering sync root to a descendant and exclude its sibling on cold and warm builds.

cases.name: named
cases.description: Build and diff Plex by name at both scopes and exercise generator withdrawal in both directions.

cases.name: named-restore
cases.description: Compare a restored FluxInstance with the committed state that omitted it.

cases.name: changed-only-authored-crds
cases.description: Keep the generated root CRD override when only the authored setting changes.

cases.name: changed-only-interval
cases.description: Report the interval change to the Kustomization emitted by the generated root.

cases.name: named-oci
cases.description: Apply an OCI-generated root in a full build and in cold and reused named Plex builds.

cases.name: named-oci-valuesfrom
cases.description: Apply the generated root when a ConfigMap supplies the sync path.
